NewsArticle.Title: Mailing Parcel: One at a Time
NewsArticle.Content: Please only mail one parcel to a recipient at a time. An error currently exists that will destroy multiple parcels sent. Make sure the recipient receives the parcel before mailing another gift. Sending mail is not affected, only gifts. Dark Ages servers are fast and stable; running well below maximum load with 0 server lag at peak volume. If you do experience latency, test your connection ( [http://www.darkages.com/support/trace_route.htm](http://www.darkages.com/support/trace_route.htm) ).
